value.rationale: The exact negative-to-positive fourth-cumulant boundary in a noise-broadened Stark lattice is a nontrivial non-Gaussian transport discriminator, not a restatement of its diffusion coefficient. A universal field/decoherence ratio guarantees positive fourth growth for arbitrary coherent hopping, while weaker fields admit exactly one coherent-strength sign crossing with a diverging threshold near the boundary. This finite-gradient non-Gaussian phase diagram is not recoverable from the prior zero-field dispersion or second-order transport rate alone; its motivation is coherent-vs-incoherent transport under Bloch localization.
